items.title: ConocoPhillips (COP) Just Drew Fresh Attention, So What Is The Market Weighing?
items.summary: Why a crude inventory surprise matters for ConocoPhillips A sharp build in US crude inventories from the Energy Information Administration rattled the energy sector, pulling ConocoPhillips (COP) lower as traders recalibrated expectations tied directly to benchmark oil prices. The reaction highlighted how tightly ConocoPhillips is linked to spot crude moves. Sentiment around the stock closely tracks shifts in supply data rather than company specific headlines. items.title: ExxonMobil Sinks 11% in a Month as Oil Slides. Darren Woods Says Its Earnings Power Comes From “Lasting Improvements”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysExxonMobil shares are down 11% in the past month as oil prices fell on hopes for an end to the Iran war, alongside a broad market selloff. Refining earned more than half of Exxon’s third-quarter adjusted profit, and the market treats that kind of windfall as temporary.
